statute: California Family Code § 1100 (via predecessor Civil Code § 5125)
originating_legislation: SB 364 (Stats. 1973, ch. 987), effective January 1, 1975; amended by Stats. 1974, ch. 1206
pre_1975_rule: Husband's management and control of community property
post_1975_rule: Equal management and control; either spouse has full authority subject to gift, family-dwelling, and (after 1986/1991 amendments) fiduciary restrictions

recodification_to_family_code.change_summary: Moved from Civ. Code § 5125 to Fam. Code § 1100 without substantive change; minor modernization and subdivision reorganization

source_note: California pre-1994 community property statutory history is traced through Deering's and West's annotation histories, which preserve former Civil Code section cross-references and Stats. chapter citations for each amendment stage.
